# superset_annotation (Resource)

Manages an annotation of an annotation layer: an event, or a period, that charts show on their time axis when they display the layer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_annotation_layer" "releases" {
  name        = "Releases"
  description = "Production releases"
}

# An instant: the start and the end are the same.
resource "superset_annotation" "v2" {
  layer_id    = superset_annotation_layer.releases.id
  short_descr = "v2.0.0"
  long_descr  = "New checkout flow"
  start_dttm  = "2026-01-15T09:00:00"
  end_dttm    = "2026-01-15T09:00:00"
}

# A period, with extra settings for the charts that display the layer.
resource "superset_annotation" "freeze" {
  layer_id    = superset_annotation_layer.releases.id
  short_descr = "Holiday freeze"
  start_dttm  = "2026-12-20T00:00:00"
  end_dttm    = "2027-01-05T00:00:00"

  json_metadata = jsonencode({ color = "#999999" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_dttm` (String) End of the annotation, in the same format, not before the start. Equal to the start for an instant.
- `layer_id` (Number) Identifier of the annotation layer. Changing it replaces the annotation.
- `short_descr` (String) Title of the annotation, unique within the layer.
- `start_dttm` (String) Start of the annotation, as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` without a time zone, for example `2026-01-15T00:00:00`.

### Optional

- `json_metadata` (String) JSON document with extra settings of the annotation.
- `long_descr` (String) Free-text description of the annotation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the annotation.
